scope: One promotion question, conditionally one Innovator, then only the accepted five-unit path; ordinary preparation accounting, no instrumentation framework

components.phase: delivery reading and live routing/owner review
accepted current scientific intake and direction
funded design and inference passage read
preserve all audit rows, finish required merge and immediate push
reuse recorded three-fit facts and exact old route template
read current substantive Issue and new-round absence
prepare machine counts/exposure and retained Issue snapshot
publish precise new Issue context and verify preserved prior discussion

cutoff: Before owner-boundary check and first input publication; later commands/Transport/Root/Monitor contributions append at the next boundary
unknown_costs: unmeasured client/message and enclosing support overhead
counting_rule: Count each invoked command/review/observation once. Preserve shared-query enclosing costs without duplicating them across directions. No unknown cost is zero; no old allocation supplies remaining credit.
